Algebra Article v1 presenter, named-range and URL adapters
Focused architecture, unit, browser, accessibility, performance, and visual evidence
Durable roadmap, decision, checkpoint, and Theseus control records

goal: Make the algebra article consume the same certified fraction-composition equation session as the canonical reader, prove sampled parity, and stop for human review before five-range promotion.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence; never mix unrelated user files.
stopConditions: Stop if canonical parity requires a fraction-specific renderer fork or canonical reader visual change.

slices.title: Reject-generic-presenter
slices.summary: Removed the rejected passage-local generic editor presenter, its transport/range extensions, styles, and visual assertions; restored the prior static article baseline and marked the checkpoint rejected with the canonical-host rationale.

slices.title: Canonical-host-provenance
slices.summary: Added an immutable canonical equation host provenance contract and a fraction-composition lock that identifies the animation, canonical reader representation and route, reader-canonical-equation runtime family, and fraction-composition descriptor; tests fail if catalog or article identity drifts.

slices.title: Generic-host-architecture-guard
slices.summary: Deleted the generic editor-player runtime, removed its CSS, reduced progressive enhancement to honest static navigation and semantic-link state, and added a directory-wide source guard plus browser proof that no generic player is constructed or hydrated.

slices.title: Pure-range-windowing
slices.summary: Added a pure reader playback-range window that observes but never advances the external global clock, maps exact local/global progress, derives forward or rewind state, preserves paused interruptions, and reports exact clock clamps on overshoot; exported it through both reader runtime APIs.

slices.title: Canonical-frame-planning
slices.summary: Extracted canonical semantic frame planning into a pure host-neutral module; the reader entry now delegates active cohort, transition, phase, and exact local progress selection while retaining its existing attention and clock inputs. Sampled parity and the full cross-browser determinism suite pass.

slices.title: Canonical-stage-shell
slices.summary: Added a canonical stage-shell mount that clones only compiler-owned markup, validates every transition and source/target measurement joint, preserves aria-hidden paint geometry and the live accessible equation region, and returns typed DOM references. The reader route now consumes it without changing compiled HTML.

slices.title: Structural-anchor-mount
slices.summary: Canonical stage mount now requires structural-anchor binding before returning and rolls back the whole mounted stage if binding fails. The reader delegates descriptor binding into that transaction; browser coverage proves every certified fraction selector resolves in each source and target instance.

slices.title: Certified-layout-extraction
slices.summary: Extracted one host-neutral canonical stage measurement, certification, responsive-fit, and application pass; canonical reader now delegates to it and wide/phone certificate checks pass.

slices.title: Canonical-compositor-lifecycle
slices.summary: Hardened the extracted canonical compositor session with explicit lifecycle inspection, idempotent disposal, use-after-dispose rejection, and stale paint-authority cleanup; browser and performance checks prove one active owner with cache/prewarm/protected-transit behavior intact.

slices.title: Fraction-salience-focus
slices.summary: Extracted one host-neutral semantic-focus projection and DOM application boundary, retained the fraction-specific cached salience scene adapter, and migrated the canonical reader without changing its frame inputs.

slices.title: Native-endpoint-accessibility
slices.summary: Extracted canonical accessible-equation ownership and native endpoint law reporting; the reader now delegates exact source/target settlement and maintains one live assistive state.

slices.title: Chrome-free-canonical-session
slices.summary: Assembled a chrome-free canonical equation session from the extracted shell, certified layout, canonical compositor, salience/focus, witnesses, endpoint, and accessibility seams. It observes caller clock samples and exposes direct seek, subscription, invalidation, and disposal without page chrome or an internal loop.

slices.title: Migrate-canonical-reader
slices.summary: Migrated the fraction-composition canonical reader to the chrome-free shared stage session while preserving the reader scroll clock, attention controls, URL state, review telemetry, and unrelated lesson renderer path.

slices.title: Canonical-visual-matrix
slices.summary: Completed the migrated-host visual and lifecycle matrix. Exact pre-loop comparison bounds six unrelated-contact families as existing clearance debt. Repaired a migration-only hidden-stage teardown invalidation regression and aligned visual tests with the global Review toolbar.

slices.title: Mount-first-article-range
slices.summary: Mounted one compiler-owned canonical equation stage and shared chrome-free session in the first algebra motion passage at the exact first-range source endpoint. The static SVG remains in the document and is hidden only after successful enhancement; generic player and autonomous clock guards remain green.
